title: On Working the north field alone
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：work　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 work 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the postman ① worked the north field alone in public, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the postman ② works the north field alone in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ work the north field alone at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ worked the north field alone before — a line in the list for June 1947 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Working the north field alone in public, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ work without a stop for two days in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Work without a stop for two days at once and never mention it again.

By 1960 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new sender from the next office ⑧ works without a stop for two days in public every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the box, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ worked the north field alone again when nobody else would.

⑩ To work the north field alone, my mother said in 1965, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody works the north field alone in silence again and somebody must work the north field alone in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 劳作（一般过去式 worked the north field alone：1953 年邮差头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 劳作（一般现在 works the north field alone：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 劳作（不定式 to work the north field alone：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 劳作（过去完成时 had worked the north field alone：1947 年六月的收发清单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 劳作（动名词 working the north field alone 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 运转（work without a stop for two days：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去运转两天不停歇地运转）
G. v. 运转（work without a stop for two days：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 劳作（后段两处：新来的寄信人照例 works without a stop for two days，而母亲又一次 worked the north field alone）

items.q: to work the north field alone

answers.why: work 意为“劳作”，1953 年邮差当着众人面劳作独自耕作北边那块地，那是邮局里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 worked。
work 意为“劳作”，自那以后邮差一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 works。
work 意为“劳作”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯劳作独自耕作北边那块地”，此处为不定式 to work the north field alone。
work 意为“劳作”，收发清单里 六月 那行字说明早在 1960 年之前就有人劳作过，故用过去完成时 had worked。
work 意为“劳作”，邮差说“劳作独自耕作北边那块地这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 working the north field alone 作主语。
work 意为“运转”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去运转两天不停歇地运转”，should ever 之后用原形 work without a stop for two days。
work 意为“运转”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻运转两天不停歇地运转（work without a stop for two days at once），以后再也不要提起。
work 意为“劳作”，新来的寄信人每个星期都照例运转两天不停歇地运转，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 works。
work 意为“劳作”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面劳作独自耕作北边那块地，用一般过去式 worked 叙述。
work 意为“劳作”，结尾那句是母亲 1965 年的话：要劳作独自耕作北边那块地，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和邮局记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 work 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the postman worked the north field alone in public, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the postman works the north field alone in silence whenever the office asks.
Working the north field alone in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever work without a stop for two days in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sender from the next office works without a stop for two days in public every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother worked the north field alone again, and the office remembered that half.
